evals.prompt: Investigate whether retrieval augmentation improves our classifier, compare several mechanisms, run the most informative experiment, and tell me what we can honestly claim.
evals.expected_output: Routes literature, comparable hypotheses, BT selection, exploratory/confirmatory choice, implementation, automatic run manifests, verification, and claim handoff.
expectations: Separates exploratory and confirmatory work before the result is observed
Uses fixed preregistration family metadata for related confirmatory tests
Describes BT intervals as uncalibrated approximate posterior summaries
Requires fresh provenance, seeds, fairness, and explicit completion criteria

evals.prompt: Continue yesterday's interrupted experiment without restarting; I think there was already a snapshot and one open preregistration.
evals.expected_output: Resumes from graph, snapshots, preregistrations, pins, manifests, and failures before choosing the next action.
expectations: Contains an explicit interrupted-work recovery branch
Inspects recorded state rather than relying on conversation memory
Preserves existing exploratory or confirmatory status

evals.prompt: Use the public ClaudeScientist plugin to start a research task in this repo. I do not have any custom agents configured.
evals.expected_output: Works inline without custom agents and gives the workspace-specific Cockpit launch command.
expectations: States that custom role agents are optional
Provides an inline fallback for every role boundary
Shows a Cockpit command with an explicit workspace
